en: Color postcard showing the central square of a Romanian town with landscaped flower beds, benches and socialist‑era apartment blocks. A rooftop propaganda sign praises the Romanian Communist Party. Reverse side has a long handwritten Romanian message, an address in Bucharest, and three Romanian stamps (a train, the Endless Column of Târgu Jiu, and a Suceava folk costume). The printed caption identifies Hațeg and says it is a view from the center.
